desc:
Oh... so that's the pun with Yōmu.

So, we all know that she's half-human, half-ghost. In Japanese, this is "`hannin hanrei`" (`半人半霊`).

Now, there is a phrase in Japanese – "`zenshin zenrei`" (`全身全霊`) literally full body, full soul – which means to do one's best.

The idea being that "`身`" can also mean person just like "`人`"
